The '''Bosph system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Bosph sector/Legends|Bosph sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bosph/Legends|Bosph]], the home of the [[Bosph (species)|Bosph]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
